content.title: Chart Industries (GTLS): $271.4M One-Off Loss Challenges Bullish Growth Narratives
content.summary: Chart Industries (GTLS) reported an earnings forecast pointing to 47.1% EPS growth annually over the next three years, far outpacing the broader US market's expected 15.7% rate. Revenue, however, is expected to grow 8.1% per year, lagging behind the US average of 10.3%. Net profit margins compressed significantly, dropping from 4% to 1%, and the latest results included a $271.4 million one-off loss, casting a shadow over otherwise robust growth projections.
